quest.51401104D4E2DD1D.quest_desc: Fire the blank in a furnace and place the Porcelain Crucible over a valid heat source. A torch directly beneath it is one option; stronger heat sources have their own values in JEI.

Feed Cobblestone: one block supplies 250 mB of lava and four supply a bucket. Remove the fluid with a bucket or compatible pipe. The task checks the finished crucible; verify heat, input and extraction in your own setup.
quest.51401104D4E2DD1D.title: A Crucible for Lava
quest.51401119D2BD7331.quest_desc: The Iron Hammer is an alternative manual tool for larger batches. It is crafted directly; the old stone hammer is not an ingredient.
The Hammer recipe defines the conversion, not a requirement to collect every tool material. Choose for durability; later automation does not require this particular hammer.
quest.51401119D2BD7331.title: A Longer-lasting Hammer
quest.5140111F9A9D12AA.quest_desc: Continue the manual chain: Cobblestone → Gravel → Sand → Ex Deorum Dust. Break each placed block with a hammer. This task requires exdeorum:dust, not another mod’s metal dust.
Dust supplies separate sieve recipes and the water-barrel recipe for clay. Keep part of your input as gravel for the main iron line.
quest.5140111F9A9D12AA.title: Dust for Clay
quest.514011297F1E5A33.quest_desc: Craft nine ordinary Gravel blocks into Compressed Gravel. This packages prepared gravel; it does not turn Compressed Cobblestone into gravel without a hammer.

Unpack it into nine Gravel for an ordinary sieve, or check the separate compressed recipe with the appropriate equipment. Do not assume a compressed block equals nine independent ordinary sieve rolls.
quest.514011297F1E5A33.title: Pack Gravel
quest.5140112A4F316BD0.quest_desc: This pack’s Golden Mesh requires an Industrial Chassis. Both the direct string-and-gold recipe and the Iron Mesh upgrade use that same material gate.

Gold does not improve every previous result: for example, its base iron-chunk chance from gravel is the same 14% as an iron mesh. Make it for the recipes you need, not as a compulsory step toward a Diamond Mesh.
quest.5140112A4F316BD0.quest_subtitle: 2 · Choose a mesh for its drops
quest.5140112A4F316BD0.title: Golden Mesh
quest.514011324616A9B3.quest_desc: Choose a Flint Mesh when its drop table suits the resource you need. It has both a direct string-and-flint recipe and a String Mesh upgrade recipe; these are alternatives.
Its base iron-chunk chance from gravel is 12%. It is not a required step before an Iron Mesh or powered machines.
quest.514011324616A9B3.quest_subtitle: 2 · Choose a mesh for its drops
quest.514011324616A9B3.title: Flint Mesh
quest.51401135F07C9A85.quest_desc: Bring End Stone from the unlocked End and hammer it into Crushed End Stone. You need access to the material and its Hammer recipe, not specifically a diamond hammer.
Match this input to the required mesh in JEI. It is an additional expedition resource branch; the first manual and powered iron lines work earlier.
quest.51401135F07C9A85.title: End Sieve Inputs
quest.514011597C161302.quest_desc: Craft a String Mesh from nine strings and fit it in the manual sieve. Ordinary-world string works; silkworms are not a required step.

Load gravel from the previous lesson. Even this mesh can produce Iron Ore Chunks: the installed recipe has a base 10% chance per gravel block. Try the process, then collect four chunks for the next node.
quest.514011597C161302.title: The First Mesh
quest.514011692B337611.quest_desc: Nine Cobblestone craft into one Compressed Cobblestone, and the reverse recipe returns nine blocks. Use it to package stored material.
Compression is not required for a Mechanical Hammer or Mechanical Sieve. Feed ordinary blocks to the basic line; JEI’s separate Compressed Hammer and Compressed Sieve categories have their own rules.
quest.514011692B337611.title: Pack Cobblestone
quest.5140116A490EBB49.quest_desc: A Diamond Mesh requires a Precision Mechanism. Use either its direct string-and-diamond recipe or the Golden Mesh upgrade.
Mechanical and Flux Sieves also work with suitable cheaper meshes. Fit diamond when you need its drops; it is also the actual base for the netherite smithing upgrade.
quest.5140116A490EBB49.quest_subtitle: 2 · Choose a mesh for its drops
quest.5140116A490EBB49.title: Diamond Mesh
quest.5140116F44752FA8.quest_desc: Craft an Iron Mesh directly from string and iron, or upgrade a Flint Mesh. The direct recipe does not require collecting every earlier mesh.
Its base Iron Ore Chunk chance from gravel is 14%. Compare the other outputs too: changing the mesh changes the drop table rather than merely speeding up right-clicking.
quest.5140116F44752FA8.quest_subtitle: 2 · Choose a mesh for its drops
quest.5140116F44752FA8.title: Iron Mesh
quest.51401172E09FFCF3.quest_desc: Craft seven Porcelain Clay Balls into an Unfired Porcelain Crucible. This is a blank vessel; it cannot produce lava yet.
Keep the unfired vessel in your inventory until this task completes, then put it in a furnace for the next step.
quest.51401172E09FFCF3.title: Shape the Crucible
quest.51401177F073D0BA.quest_desc: For a short route to clay, fill an Oak Barrel with water: one Ex Deorum Dust plus 1000 mB of water gives a Clay block. Break it into clay balls for porcelain clay.
An empty barrel also supports composting, for example with leaves or Wood Chippings. Keep the processes distinct: compost filling and dust mixed with water use different recipes.
quest.51401177F073D0BA.title: A Barrel for Clay
quest.5140117CFCDA03E8.quest_desc: A Diamond Hammer is another manual-tool option, not a separate factory milestone. Its own recipe does not require an Industrial Chassis.

Keep it in your inventory until the task completes before crafting with it or fitting it in a machine. The Mechanical Hammer also accepts cheaper hammers in its recipe, and its internal tool slot is optional.
quest.5140117CFCDA03E8.title: Diamond Hammer
quest.5140117D1731679A.quest_desc: Combine a Clay Ball with Bone Meal to make a Porcelain Clay Ball. Ordinary clay and porcelain clay are different items.
The task checks one ball, but an unfired crucible needs seven and an unfired bucket needs another three. Prepare enough for the vessel you choose.
quest.5140117D1731679A.title: Porcelain Clay
quest.5140118233B3CC83.quest_desc: Move the sifting process you already understand into a Mechanical Sieve. Its Expert recipe needs a Precision Mechanism, Electromechanical Drive and Industrial Chassis; it does not include a diamond mesh.

Fit a suitable mesh in its separate slot before feeding gravel to the input. Supply FE from a generator and cable; the installed consumption is 40 FE per working tick. Drops enter twenty internal output slots that automation can extract from.

Keep space for the different results and check redstone mode. A string mesh still supports the familiar iron recipe. Continue with the Ex Machinis Flux Sieve for an external receiver and machine upgrades.
quest.5140118233B3CC83.quest_subtitle: Powered sifting after the manual sieve
quest.5140118233B3CC83.title: The First FE Sieve
quest.514011876B475765.quest_desc: An Oak Crucible provides an alternative water source: one leaf block yields 250 mB, so four supply a bucket. Feed leaves into the wooden crucible and let them process.
This is a water crucible, not a lava crucible. Natural water also works in the normal world; the wooden crucible is not a compulsory predecessor to porcelain.
quest.514011876B475765.title: Water from Plants
quest.5140118A7959CF14.quest_desc: This is a real continuation of the Diamond Mesh: the smithing recipe needs that mesh, a netherite ingot and a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template.
Check the exact input-and-mesh pair before a large batch. This branch expands your drop options; it is not needed to start the first powered line.
quest.5140118A7959CF14.quest_subtitle: 2 · Choose a mesh for its drops
quest.5140118A7959CF14.title: Netherite Mesh
quest.5140118C20D4ED91.quest_desc: A hammer turns Deepslate or Cobbled Deepslate into Crushed Deepslate. This is another sieve input, not a mandatory tier after gravel.

Compare the desired output with the same mesh in JEI: for example, a string mesh has a base 12% iron-chunk chance here, versus 10% for gravel. Choose the input for the resource you need and the stock you have.
quest.5140118C20D4ED91.title: Crushed Deepslate
quest.514011A427A0E346.quest_desc: Craft a Stone Barrel from ordinary stone and a stone slab. Use it for the appropriate hot-fluid processes; the wooden barrel still serves water-and-dust clay and compost.

One next setup feeds lava from the porcelain crucible into a stone barrel and uses water for the Obsidian recipe. Check JEI’s Barrel Fluid Mixing category and test the fluid arrangement with a small batch first.
quest.514011A427A0E346.title: A Barrel for Lava
quest.514011B17B9019ED.quest_desc: A Stone Hammer prepares the sieve input: break a placed Cobblestone block with it to obtain Gravel. Continue Gravel → Sand → Dust when you need those other drop tables.
Stop crushing at the material your recipe needs. The first iron chunks use gravel; turning the entire batch into dust changes the available drops.
quest.514011B17B9019ED.title: Stone into Gravel
quest.514011B76E41FE36.quest_desc: First craft three Porcelain Clay Balls into an Unfired Porcelain Bucket, then fire it in a furnace. This task requires the finished Porcelain Bucket.
It is a parallel product from the same clay, not a required crucible component. Use it to move fluid between compatible containers.
quest.514011B76E41FE36.title: Fire a Bucket
quest.514011BEF463278A.quest_desc: After the expedition, bring Netherrack and hammer it into Crushed Netherrack. This supplies different sieve tables; gravel does not need to pass through this stage.
Use JEI to find the desired output for Crushed Netherrack with your mesh. Another hammer step turns it into Red Sand, so stop the line here when you want Nether drops.
quest.514011BEF463278A.title: Nether Sieve Inputs
quest.514011C77F670381.quest_desc: This is a parallel output of the same manual process. With the installed Mekanism ore, a String Mesh has a base 3% chance of an Osmium Ore Chunk from gravel; other meshes and crushed deepslate use their own tables.

Keep four chunks until the task completes. The chunk-assembly recipe returns an ore from c:ores/osmium; check its selected output in JEI. An Industrial Chassis is not needed to start collecting these chunks.
quest.514011C77F670381.title: Osmium from Gravel
quest.514011CA86FD67E8.quest_desc: The Mechanical Hammer is already an FE-powered Ex Deorum machine. Its Expert recipe needs a Precision Mechanism, Electromechanical Drive, Industrial Chassis and Dark Steel; any ordinary hammer in exdeorum:hammers fits the crafting recipe.

Supply FE, put Cobblestone in the input and collect Gravel from the output. One machine performs one step of the chain; reaching sand or dust without manual transfers needs further stages or recirculation.

The installed consumption is 20 FE per working tick. A separate hammer in the internal tool slot is optional: it speeds processing and takes durability damage. Check power, redstone mode and output space before continuous feeding.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Dark Steel Ingot.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Mechanical Hammer. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.514011CA86FD67E8.title: The First FE Hammer
quest.514011D7E21C7052.quest_desc: Collect four Iron Ore Chunks by sifting gravel. A string mesh is enough; an iron mesh raises the base chance from 10% to 14%, but is not required for this quest. An unsuccessful attempt can yield no chunk.

Keep all four chunks in your inventory until the task completes, then arrange them in a 2×2 crafting square to obtain one Iron Ore block. Smelt it or feed it into your existing ore processing. Continue to the Mechanical Sieve when you need a continuous supply.
quest.514011D7E21C7052.title: First Iron Chunks
quest.514011DC6D0EDF31.quest_desc: Break a log with a hammer: the recipe yields three to eight Wood Chippings. This wood-processing branch is independent of more expensive meshes.
Chippings can be composted in a barrel. Use stone materials for the ore line; this recipe does not turn wood into gravel.
quest.514011DC6D0EDF31.title: Chippings for Compost
quest.514011FBFE3B594B.quest_desc: The main route is to prepare gravel with a hammer, fit a string mesh and collect your first four iron ore chunks. This is a usable resource route in the normal world; no skyblock start is needed.

Place an Oak Sieve, fit a mesh, load a valid block and use right-click to sift it. Drops belong to a specific input-and-mesh pair; check the Sieve category in JEI. More expensive meshes are side branches, and making every mesh is not required before automation.
quest.514011FBFE3B594B.title: The Manual Sieve
